lessons.title: Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Phrasal Verbs in Village Life
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Phrasal Verbs in Village Life.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: A verb combined with an adverb or a preposition that creates a meaning different from the original verb.
concepts.example: pass down (truyền lại), look around (ngắm nghía xung quanh), set up (khởi nghiệp/thành lập), live on (sống dựa vào).
concepts.essence: Mastering phrasal verbs makes English speaking and writing sound natural and authentic.

concepts.definition: Sentences containing an independent clause and at least one dependent clause introduced by subordinator: because/since (reason), so that (purpose), although (concession).
concepts.example: Although the pottery was handmade, it was sold at an affordable price.
concepts.essence: Used to link ideas logically in essays and descriptive paragraphs.

rules.statement: Adverb clauses of purpose with 'so that' / 'in order that'
rules.meaning: Subject + Verb + so that + Subject + can/could/will/would + Verb (bare infinitive).
rules.example: We woke up early so that we could catch the first bus to Bat Trang ceramic village.
rules.essence: Expresses the specific goal or aim of the action in the main clause.

workedExamples.prompt: Rewrite the sentence using the phrasal verb in brackets: 'My grandparents started this workshop twenty years ago.' (SET UP)
steps: Bước 1: Nhận diện động từ 'started' ở thì quá khứ đơn (Past Simple).
Bước 2: Cụm động từ tương đương là 'set up' (quá khứ của set vẫn là set).
Bước 3: Viết lại câu: 'My grandparents set up this workshop twenty years ago.'
workedExamples.answer: My grandparents set up this workshop twenty years ago.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'although' and 'but' together in the same sentence: 'Although he was tired, but he finished the craft.'
commonMistakes.why: In English, never use 'although' and 'but' in the same sentence. Remove 'but': 'Although he was tired, he finished the craft.'
